questions.hint: Asexual reproduction involves a single parent and no gametes.

questions.question: The protective layer that surrounds the cell membrane in plant cells is made up of:

options.explanation: Proteins are not the primary component of the plant cell wall.
Cellulose is the main component of the plant cell wall.
Lipids are not the primary component of the plant cell wall.
Chitin is found in fungal cell walls, not plant cell walls.

questions.explanation: The cell wall in plant cells is primarily composed of cellulose, which provides structural support and protection. Proteins, lipids, and chitin are not the main components of the plant cell wall.
questions.hint: Cellulose is a carbohydrate that forms the structure of plant cell walls.
